ideas.text: An AI comment generator that leaves "this" under every post to preserve your professional brand.
A viral video copilot that inserts subway-surfing footage into family announcements.
A group chat assistant that translates gossip into compliant stakeholder feedback.
A meme agent that A/B tests punchlines against follower churn.
An influencer CRM that tracks which friends are most likely to become content.
An AI thirst-trap planner that optimizes lighting, timing, and plausible deniability.
A social scheduler that posts inspirational quotes whenever your bank account falls below a threshold.
A podcast clipper that adds captions even when they make you look illiterate.
An AI wedding hashtag generator that treats every marriage like a product launch.
A content strategy bot that turns grief into a 12-part carousel.
A parasociality dashboard measuring how many strangers would miss you if you stopped posting.
An AI PR coach that recommends crying in serif fonts for better engagement.
A livestream copilot that detects dead air and starts fake controversy.
A social listening tool that notifies you when someone subtweets your niche badly.
An AI fan club manager that auto-likes criticism to seem above it.
A newsletter assistant that stretches one mediocre thought into 1,800 words and three affiliate links.
A photo selector that ranks selfies by founder energy and avoidant attachment.
A trend forecaster that convinces you to start a channel about things you actively hate.
An AI voice clone that records fake "hey bestie" intros while you sleep.
A doomscrolling dashboard with weekly analytics and relapse forecasts.
An app that converts your Notes app rants into a single sentence before you screenshot them to a friend.
A tool that detects when you've drafted a text and not sent it for 3 days and just deletes it for you.
An app that translates 'I'm just busy right now' into the specific person you're avoiding.
An AI that detects when your group chat has gone silent for 6 days after one person sent a hot take.
A bot that flags when someone has been added to the group chat and not introduced themselves in 3 weeks.
An app that converts the group chat title into the actual dynamic, updated weekly.
A tool that detects when one person has been carrying 80% of the messages and stages a wellness check.
An AI that translates 'down for whatever' from 5 friends into 'no one is making the plan.'
A bot that detects when the brunch plan thread has exceeded 200 messages and no decision has been made.
An app that flags when 'we should hang out soon' has been in the chat 4 times this year without a date.
A tool that detects when someone replies only with 'haha' and never anything else.
An AI that converts the group chat's last 30 days into who actually plans, who lurks, and who just reacts.
A bot that detects when 'unread: 247' has become spiritually load-bearing for you.
An AI that detects when your hot-take tweet is just a thought you had 4 minutes ago for the first time.
A bot that flags 'unpopular opinion' posts where the opinion is in fact the most popular one this week.
An app that converts your quote-tweet into the DM you should have sent.
A tool that detects when you've drafted a tweet, deleted it, and then thought about it for the rest of the day.
An AI that translates 'just thinking out loud' into the position you'd defend to the death.
A bot that detects when your reply is 'this' with no context, repeatedly.
An app that flags when you've subtweeted the same person 3 times this month.
A tool that detects when your timeline is fully one ongoing fight you have no stake in.
An AI that converts 'mute, not block' into the 14 people you should have just blocked.
A bot that detects when your tweet went viral and you've been refreshing for 5 hours.
